question: How many triangles can be formed using the vertices of a regular dodecagon (a 12-sided polygon)?
solution:
The 12 vertices lie on a circle, and a line intersects a circle in at most two points. Thus every set of three vertices forms a triangle. There are $12\cdot11\cdot10$ ordered choices of three distinct vertices, and each triangle is counted in $3!=6$ orders. The number of triangles is $12\cdot11\cdot10/6=220$.
Final answer: 220
